claims.claim: 每个状态标签都是「图标 + 文字」，图标形状各不相同
claims.evidence: list-01.png status column: 处理中 half-circle, 已派单 arrow, 待派单 dashed circle, 待验收 check-circle, 已挂起 pause, 已关闭 check. Every one has a text label.

claims.claim: 优先级标签始终带「P1–P4」代码和「紧急/高/中/低」文字
claims.evidence: list-01.png and list-02.png priority column: every row shows a code chip plus a word (P1 紧急, P2 高, P3 中, P4 低), and the fill gets lighter from P1 to P4.

claims.claim: 已超时且未完成的行（0402、0371）：SLA 显示为实心红色标签（白字 + 警示三角），行底色为浅红，行首加 4px 红色竖条。选中的超时行（0402）底色改为选中蓝
claims.evidence: list-01.png rows 0402 and 0371: solid red SLA chips with white text and a triangle ('已超时 12分', '已超时 1时05分') and a red left bar. 0371 has a light-red row background; the selected 0402 row has a blue background but keeps the red chip and bar.

claims.claim: 「修复剩 3时30分」→「剩 3时30分 / 修复时限」…「剩 2天」「剩 6天」就不加第二行
claims.evidence: list-01.png row 0413 SLA shows '剩 3时30分' over '修复时限'. Rows 0387 ('剩 2天') and 0333 (list-02.png, '剩 6天') are single-line.

claims.claim: 剩余时间少于 1 小时显示为「临近」（琥珀色时钟、加粗）
claims.evidence: list-01.png row 0409: '剩 35分' is bold amber with an amber clock icon. Rows with more time left (0413, 0398) use a gray clock.

claims.claim: 批量操作栏显示「已选 2 项（本页）」，并提供「选择全部 1,286 项」的入口
claims.evidence: list-01.png bulk bar: '已选 2 项（本页）', 批量派单, 批量修改优先级, 导出所选, 取消选择 and the link '选择全部 1,286 项'. The header checkbox is indeterminate and rows 0409 and 0402 are checked.

claims.claim: 空状态：生效的三个条件在下拉框上高亮，并以可删除的标签列出；页面给出两个下一步
claims.evidence: list-empty-01.png: the 状态, 厂区/产线 and 负责人 dropdowns have a blue highlight. The '已筛选' row has three removable chips plus 清除全部. The two buttons are '移除「负责人 = 王建国」' and '清除全部筛选'.

claims.claim: 加载状态：快捷视图的数量、表格行、总条数都显示为骨架，工具栏写「正在加载工单…」并带转圈图标
claims.evidence: list-loading-01.png: the tab counts are gray pills, the table rows are skeletons, and the toolbar shows a spinner with '正在加载工单...'. list-loading-02.png footer shows '共 [skeleton] 条'. The filters render normally.

claims.claim: 出错状态：快捷视图不显示数量…写明 HTTP 502、请求编号 7f3a-91c2-0d44、时间 09:42:17…提供「重试」和「复制请求编号」
claims.evidence: list-error-01.png: the tabs have no counts. The body says 'HTTP 502' and '筛选条件已保留', and a box shows '请求编号 7f3a-91c2-0d44 时间 09:42:17'. The buttons are 复制请求编号 and 重试.

claims.claim: 「更多」操作…直接放在面包屑那一行右侧…「关闭工单」用红色文字
claims.evidence: detail-01.png: the breadcrumb row's right side shows 打印工单, 复制链接 and 关闭工单, with 关闭工单 in red and a no-entry icon.

claims.claim: 标题直接说结论「2 小时内升高 22.3 °C，仍在上升」；55 °C 阈值画成虚线…标出 08:50 越过阈值
claims.evidence: detail-01.png and detail-02.png chart: the title matches the quote. There is a red dashed line labeled '阈值 55', the points after 08:50 are red, and a dotted marker is labeled '08:50 越过阈值'.
